question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Exquisite
solution:
The correct answer is: **Beautiful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Exquisite"** means something that is extremely beautiful or carefully designed, often with a fine or delicate quality. (अति सुंदर)
 
 
• **Example: **She wore an exquisite gown that caught everyone's attention at the party.
 
 
• **"Beautiful"** refers to something that is aesthetically pleasing or delightful to the senses. (सुंदर)
 
 
• **Example: **The sunset over the mountains was so beautiful that it left everyone speechless.
